inlines.v: REDIN'TEGRATE, verb transitive [Latin redintegro; red, re, and integro, from integer, whole.] To make whole again; to renew; to restore to a perfect state. REDIN'TEGRATE, adjective Renewed; restored to wholeness or a perfect state.
